summary: Validate route policy using one consistent configuration snapshot

delivery.outcome: Validate every route against one freshly loaded runtime policy per operation, retaining all candidate checks while avoiding repeated configuration reads and unused evidence hashing during usage-ingest planning.
nonGoals: No provider or model priority changes
No persistent policy cache or weaker validation
No collector timeout changes, provider retry, live usage backfill or service rollout

architecture.decision: Extract private route selection/validation accepting a RuntimePolicyConfig snapshot. Public configured_routes retains fresh reads and evidence digests. validate_policy reuses its fresh snapshot and does not generate unused per-route digests.
architecture.rollback: Revert exact reviewed source change; preserve diagnostic measurements.

validation.evidence: All routes remain validated, public routing evidence remains unchanged, each validation observes a fresh single configuration snapshot.

commands: same-source offline benchmark and public route digest comparison
protected current-base OneDev and independent Validator publication
validation.evidence: Compare exact catalog/snapshot results without provider invocations; independently review and publish the frozen head.
